pure-announcement.rationale: The page is solely vendor promotion — three customer testimonials plus a founder quote for Anystack — with no technical content and no idea that transfers beyond the product itself.

duplicate.rationale: Nothing in the corpus resembles this; the nearest concepts (RAG, MCP extensions, skills) are unrelated to app distribution marketing.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The central claims are subjective testimonials ('saved me countless hours', 'would never have been able to launch') with no mechanism, data or primary source a reader could check.

durability.rationale: Marketing testimonial copy carries no claim that will be true-and-useful in twelve months; there is nothing here to age well or badly.

actionability.rationale: There are no steps, mechanisms or trade-offs — nothing a reader could build or decide differently after reading.

atomicity.rationale: The only statable content is a product pitch ('Anystack handles billing and update distribution for Electron/Tauri apps'), not an articulable concept.
